title: File transfers
description: Upload, download, and protect file versions with byte ranges and ETags.

sections.title: PUT /v1/files/:id/content
paragraphs: Send file bytes directly as the request body. A new ID returns 201; an existing ID returns 200 with updated metadata. An upload without Content-Range replaces the whole content.

sections.title: GET /v1/files/:id/content
paragraphs: A full read returns 200. A satisfiable byte range returns 206 with Content-Range, Content-Length, and ETag. An invalid range returns 416.

sections.title: Protect a version
paragraphs: Use If-Match with the file ETag to guard a read or write. A mismatch returns 412. Refresh metadata and decide how to handle the conflict instead of retrying blindly.

Content-Range supports partial uploads. The current server implementation assembles the full object in memory, so size the server for your files and do not treat the API as a constant-memory streaming uploader.

sections.title: Trash and restore
paragraphs: DELETE /v1/files/:id moves a file to trash. POST /v1/files/:id/restore restores it while retained. Files become eligible for purge after 30 days.
